correctness.rationale: Buzaglo-Rogalski Lemma 6.4 identifies Delta_n as the sum-congruence subgroup of (Z/(3n))^3 rtimes C3 with coordinate rotation. Direct fixed-translation analysis gives center C_{3n}; two independent commutator translation vectors have Smith normal form diag(1,3), producing derived subgroup C_{3n} x C_n; presentation abelianization has Smith normal form diag(1,3,3n). Every nontrivial rotational element cubes to a diagonal translation; a has order 9n. The group is a 3-group iff n has no prime divisor besides 3; otherwise a Sylow 3-element rotates a nontrivial p-primary translation subgroup, excluding nilpotency. Independent SymPy Smith computations verified n=1,2,3,5,7,9,12. The proof works for every n>=1.
